capabilities: Parse SRT and VTT cue lists from files in the vault
Filter cues and select individual sentences for export
Mark an exact cloze span or enter a question and answer per cue
Preview and create a Markdown note with source paths, cue numbers and timestamps
Save card templates and combine cues from multiple subtitle files (Pro)
disambiguation: Does not connect to Anki or any study tool; the cloze syntax is plain text in the Markdown note and no media player or subtitle downloader is included.
extras: Freemium: core features are free; saved templates and combining sources require a paid GitHub Sponsors sponsorship and GitHub device-flow sign-in. Pro checks work offline up to 14 days. The plugin is not staff-reviewed by Obsidian, opens a What's new tab after updates promoting other NoteMods plugins, and its untested areas include mobile apps, very large files and third-party study tool importers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read subtitle files and turn selected sentences into study cards that still reference their source cue and timestamps.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features
GitHub account sign-in for Pro features

summary: Sentence card creator that turns local SRT and VTT subtitle files into Markdown study notes, keeping each card's source path, cue number and timestamps.
